project_type: Python FastAPI + Jinja2 multi-agent investment analysis platform
verification_instructions: Run pytest, ensure all 448+ tests pass. Do NOT modify test files.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 available. yfinance installed.
contribution_requirements: Commit messages in Chinese. Work on main branch. Each task = 1 commit. Do not modify test files. Do not add frontend frameworks (React/Vue/Chart.js). Use vanilla JS + SVG only.
key_patterns: FastAPI app in dashboard/app.py, templates in dashboard/templates/ (Jinja2 extends base.html), static CSS in dashboard/static/css/bloomberg.css, JS in dashboard/static/js/i18n.js. Data layer in src/augur/data.py with provider chain. Personas in src/augur/personas/. Config in src/augur/config.py. Version defined in pyproject.toml and referenced in app.py and base.html.
directory_structure: dashboard/ (FastAPI app, templates, static), src/augur/ (core logic, data, personas, registry, report), tests/ (pytest), docs/ (images, changelog, guides), personas/ (YAML persona definitions), config/ (YAML configs)
